findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "I used to spend 30 minutes every day collecting " → 4 lines (21 words, 37.4px, a paragraph set above 36px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 1 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "ChopDrop" above "Lunch is cheaper together."
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "ChopDrop pools your office lunch orders " 4.3:1 needs 4.5:1; "Browse menu" 4.3:1 needs 4.5:1; "Log in" 4.3:1 needs 4.5:1; "Join office" 4.3:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (4.3:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Only 6 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 438px of the width empty: "AO".
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.
Check that it is a deliberate rest (once per page at most); otherwise close it to the normal section gap.

findings.message: A section carries text but no heading: section.relative at 8575px.
findings.fix: Name it with a short heading unless it is the continuation of the section above.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Menu" (screen 10, 50% hidden); "Start" (screen 10, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.
